description:

Featuring first goals and first wins, these highlights capture moments these players will always remember as they forge their future in the league.

description:
After a give-and-go with Dylan Larkin, Axel Sandin-Pellikka takes the return pass, gets to the middle, and wires a wrister through traffic for his first career NHL goal. The 2023 first-rounder is already showing off his offensive instincts — a glimpse of what Detroit hopes he’ll bring for years to come.

description:
Fresh off a faceoff win in the offensive zone in overtime, the Flyers set up on a 5-on-3 power play. Christian Dvorak fed Porter Martone in the high slot, and the 6th overall pick in the 2025 NHL Draft wired a shot that was kicked out before the 19-year-old rookie pounced on the rebound and banged it home at 2:31 for his first career NHL goal.
The Peterborough product’s overtime winner lifted Philadelphia to a huge 2-1 victory during their playoff push.
